name: U.S. Ordnance M60 7.62x51 Light Machine Gun
teaser: Port of the M60 from the new Tarkov wipe.
description_html:
Special thanks to the SPT devs for dumping the relevant json files required for these mods to work, and for everything else!

IMPORTANT NOTE: I am seeing some reports of issues potentially stemming from the missing new bipod mechanics. If you run across any issues with this mod, when reloading or using the gun, try removing the bipod and running without it. Please also report back in the comments!

Installation:

Download the .zip file, extract all, and add the folder MC-M60 to your user/mods/ folder in SPT. Make sure it is just the folder with all of the contents, not a folder with another MC-M60 folder inside of it, else the mod will probably throw an error!

The directory should look like this:

/user/mods/MC-M60/

and not this:

/user/mods/MC-M60_X.X.X/MC-M60/

Uninstalling:

If for whatever reason you need to remove this mod, make sure you delete any new items that this mod adds from your inventory before you delete the mod folder!

Known Issues:

  • I believe the trigger group is a new type of pistol grip assembly to the game, and therefore the icon for it is missing, but it still functions fine it seems like. If anyone knows how to fix this please let me know.
  • There also seems to be some error relating to the “MagazineInHandsVisualController”. If anyone happens to know what is causing this, please let me know. As far as I can tell it is not causing any gameplay breaking issues.

Please let me know if you run into any other issues!
